message: As I was sipping my morning tea, I stumbled upon a delightful resource that reminded me how small steps in preparedness can turn into cozy family gatherings. It’s all about safety skills and learning together—whether it’s practicing how to make a plan or just chatting about what to do in unexpected moments. 🌼 It’s comforting to think that by preparing a little now, we can make any situation a bit easier and even a bit fun! Have you tried turning preparedness into a family activity?
